operators.name: max_pool3d_forward
semantics: Computes the equivalent of torch.nn.functional.max_pool3d(input, kernel_size, stride, padding, dilation, ceil_mode=False) using cuDNN pooling.

The kernel_size, stride, and padding arguments are tuples of three ints, but the binding exposes them as int64_t arguments according to the extension contract; they are passed unchanged to the launcher.
No bias or extra computation is involved; the output is the maximum value in each pooling window.
The output shape is [1024, 3, 32, 17, 17] for the provided configuration.
Calls nn.MaxPool3d with kernel_size=(1,2,2), stride=(1,2,2), padding=(0,1,1), dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
Returns a float32 CUDA tensor of shape [1024, 3, 32, 17, 17].
